description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki Ignition Switch for the Suzuki SJ410 & SJ413 Samurai
Comes with 2 Keys
Note: The ignition switch has an OEM Style Connector that is plug & play. The Accessory door wire is not included. (That means if you have the key in the ignition and you open the drivers door, the buzzer will not sound. This is especially convenient if you take off your doors from time to time)
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Ignition Switch
Qty 2 – Keys
Qty 2 – Attachment Bolts – Ignition Switch
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
